name: node-upload-api
title: Node resumable uploads
blurb: A resumable upload service with no dependencies: the client declares a name and a size, sends byte ranges at offsets it has to get right, and gets a SHA-256 of the whole file when the last byte lands.

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
set -e
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5456/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "port 5456 is already answering - stop that process before running this step" >&2
  exit 1
fi
work=$(mktemp -d)
log=$(mktemp)
server=""
trap 'kill -TERM $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$work" "$log"' EXIT
UPLOAD_DIR=$work/data PORT=5456 node src/main.js >"$log" 2>&1 &
server=$!
ready=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5456/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then cat "$log" >&2; exit 1; fi
kill -0 "$server"
body=$work/body.json
fail=0
check() {
  if [ "$2" = "$3" ]; then echo "ok $1"; else echo "FAIL $1: want [$3] got [$2]"; fail=1; fi
}
has() { if grep -Fq -- "$2" "$body"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }
status() { curl -sS -o "$body" -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
base=http://127.0.0.1:5456
printf 'hello resumable world\n' >"$work/source.txt"
size=$(wc -c <"$work/source.txt")
check health "$(status "$base/health")" 200
check create "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"source.txt\",\"size\":$size}" "$base/uploads")" 201
id=$(sed -n 's/.*"id":"\([0-9a-f]*\)".*/\1/p' "$body")
if [ -n "$id" ]; then echo "ok created_id"; else echo "FAIL created_id: empty"; fail=1; fi
check missing_name "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"size":4}' "$base/uploads")" 422
check too_large "$(status -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"x","size":2097152}' "$base/uploads")" 413
check invalid_json "$(status -X POST -d '{oops' "$base/uploads")" 422
head -c 8 "$work/source.txt" >"$work/part1"
tail -c +9 "$work/source.txt" >"$work/part2"
check wrong_offset "$(status -X PUT --data-binary @"$work/part1" "$base/uploads/$id?offset=8")" 409
check wrong_offset_expected "$(has expected '"expected":0')" yes
check chunk1 "$(status -X PUT --data-binary @"$work/part1" "$base/uploads/$id?offset=0")" 200
check content_incomplete "$(status "$base/uploads/$id/content")" 409
check chunk2 "$(status -X PUT --data-binary @"$work/part2" "$base/uploads/$id?offset=8")" 200
want=$(sha256sum "$work/source.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
check digest "$(has "$want" "$want")" yes
check content "$(status "$base/uploads/$id/content")" 200
if cmp -s "$body" "$work/source.txt"; then echo "ok content_bytes"; else echo "FAIL content_bytes: differs"; fail=1; fi
check unknown "$(status "$base/uploads/deadbeefdeadbeef")" 404
check not_found "$(status "$base/nope")" 404
check not_found_detail "$(has 'no route for GET /nope' 'no route for GET /nope')" yes
check wrong_method "$(status -X POST "$base/health")" 405
check delete "$(status -X DELETE "$base/uploads/$id")" 204
check deleted "$(status "$base/uploads/$id")" 404
if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then echo "upload contract failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
